concepts.name: adapter
concepts.definition: A source adapter: one class under recall/sources that detects its own export under data/ and yields chunks, registered in ADAPTERS.

concepts.name: chunk
concepts.definition: One embeddable unit of the archive: a stable ref, its text, its source and its date, stored as one row of the chunk table.

concepts.name: ref
concepts.definition: The stable identity of a chunk, such as email:<thread>#2. The ingest compares stored refs and digests, and an answer cites the ref it read.

concepts.name: digest
concepts.definition: The md5 of a chunk's cleaned text, equal to Postgres md5(text), which decides whether a stored chunk is pending.

concepts.name: budget
concepts.definition: The most characters one chunk may hold for one adapter, derived by calibration from the densest sample.

concepts.name: calibrate
concepts.definition: To measure the lowest characters per token ratio in an adapter's samples and derive its chunk budget from it.

concepts.name: arm
concepts.definition: One of the two retrieval paths: the dense arm ranks by vector distance and the sparse arm by full text rank.

concepts.name: citation
concepts.definition: A bracketed source number in an answer, such as [2], that points at the second source the prompt gave the model.

concepts.name: attribution
concepts.definition: The rule that an answer names whose experience a source reports, so another person's words never read as the user's own.

concepts.name: zone
concepts.definition: The IANA time zone that RECALL_TZ names, used to read local times in an export.

concepts.name: receipt
concepts.definition: A purchase confirmation mail that the mbox allowlist keeps even when it also carries Category Updates.

concepts.name: handle
concepts.definition: An identifier of a person in one source: a phone number in the form the store holds, an email address, or a Twitter account id. Thread members and event senders in the store are handles.

concepts.name: label
concepts.definition: The display name that the contacts map or an export gives a handle. Several handles can share one label, and the store resolves a sender or a member to its label.

concepts.name: folded name
concepts.definition: A label as resolve compares it: case, accents, emoji and punctuation removed, an apostrophe closed up. A folded name owns every handle whose label folds to it, and a partial name matches only at the start of a word of it.

concepts.name: ask-back
concepts.definition: The answer that code writes when a count cannot resolve its person: the matching names with their message counts, or the fact that nothing matches, and a request to ask again with one name. It cites the table and calls no model.

concepts.name: active day
concepts.definition: A local day in RECALL_TZ on which a count's day rule finds a message: in the one-to-one thread from either side, or from the person in a group. A count reports active days in total and per period.

concepts.name: silent day
concepts.definition: A local day with no message under the same day rule as an active day, between two active days. A gap counts silent days.

concepts.name: date range
concepts.definition: The start and the end that parse_dates reads from a question, the end exclusive. since X ends at the end of today; from X to Y, X to Y and between X and Y end at the end of Y; a lone period is itself. The range bounds retrieval, a count, and a top call that names no year.

concepts.name: store end
concepts.definition: The local day of the newest row of a source in the store. A count states it, so an answer can tell an export that ends early from silence.
